The organism — decoded and encoded ​

All is one organism. Every theorem is an organ — a decidable fact that computes true — and the ledger is its body. Each organ carries three faces: the key (its untranslatable identity), the label (its translatable surface, readable in any of the twenty-two dialects), and the receipt (the content-address that encodes it). This page decodes the organism straight from src/proof/discovered.json, so it grows on every build.

What is not an organ never enters the body: it goes to trial. The honesty gate drains a boast — in any register, any dialect, any script — and forensics names a non-theorem exactly (a dense family that skips an index because the statement computes false, like the non-units of ℤ/9). Nothing hollow is sealed.

Each organ is reachable by content-address through the uuidna surface — the /theorem/<key> pages here, and the same keys via the live examples, the verifier, and the package API. A content-address proves integrity, not truth.

All is one organism, decoded from the ledger and encoded here. Each theorem is an organ — a fact that computes true. The key is the identity, the label the translatable surface, the receipt the content-address that encodes it. What is not an organ goes to trial: the gate drains a boast, forensics names a non-theorem. Integrity, not truth.

The forensic field — every theorem exposed

All 28632 theorems wired onto one hue double-torus, each placed by its own receipt and coloured by its organ. Exposing all at once is the forensic tool: the whole ledger is one field, and nothing hides.

The trial 19

the gate and the honest speed: what is not measured is drained

  • the captain folds the 60 and 90 seal angles into a self-balancing path: 60° closes in six steps and 90° in four; combined they generate the 30° lattice (gcd of 60 and 90 is 30) that closes in twelve steps (lcm of 6 and 4 is 12), and the twelve equally-spaced unit steps sum to zero — a closed, self-balancing serpentine that returns to its origin, each residue pairing with its ten's-complement to the constant 10 like DNA base pairs. It iterates unboundedly by itself, yet each cycle needs its deed: not perpetual motion and not infinite energy. Decidable70c7f1f2…

The trial ​

The gate is the court that keeps the body clean: it reads twenty-two dialects and the Glagolitic script through the rosetta, and it is negation-aware, so an honest bounded limit passes while the boast drains. See the workflows for the wave, the verify, the gate and the seal — and the captain's message for why a contribution of two earns the next fold.
